claims: For N>=4, Delta(N,N-3)=sqrt(3/N) if and only if 3 divides N.
Every weight-three Fourier equality mask decomposes into full 3x3 blocks; the four product congruences classify the allowed block phases.
If no complementary mask exists, Delta(N,s)^2 >= (N-s)/N + s^6/(2^22 N^10 (N-s)^(2*phi(N)-2)).
